# WO-213: Accessibility tests for the "Is this you?" dashboard card
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Nora assigns
Agent: test-quality
Source: CLAUDE-048 (new UI from inhouse/is-this-you, SEC-122/123)

## Goal
Lock the new REVIEW_MATCH card's accessibility with offline browser tests, extending the existing app sweep (tests/codex/test_cx_app_a11y_sweep.py pattern).

## Acceptance criteria
- Card at 1024x768 and 1280x800, light and dark: "Yes, this is me", "No, this is not me", "Open the page" are reachable by Tab in a sensible order, activate with Enter/Space, have >=44px targets, visible focus, text >=20px, body contrast >=7:1 and other text >=4.5:1.
- After each answer the flash message is announced (role=status or equivalent as implemented; report if missing, don't change src/).
- Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson); the card must not show listing values (assert none of the seeded values appear).
- Offline, real Chromium via the existing fixtures; no wall-clock waits.

## Allowed paths
- `tests/codex/test_cx_review_card_a11y.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope
No src/ changes. Report defects as findings with file:line.

## Required checks
- `PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_review_card_a11y.py tests/test_wizard_review_match.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex`
